title: 3. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
constraints:
• 0 <= len(s) <= 5 * 10^4
• `s` consists of English letters, digits, symbols, and spaces.
• Optimal Time: O(N) | Optimal Space: O(min(N, Sigma))
explanation: A variable-size sliding window tracks the most recent index of each character. When a duplicate is detected within the current window (`last_seen[ch] >= left`), the left boundary jumps directly to `last_seen[ch] + 1` in O(1), achieving a single-pass O(N) scan.
